::: {.callout-note}
## Source inspected
The public article was read. It uses the place-name **Creekside**, not Creekview.
:::

## Annotation

The article states that in 1985 Lawrence “joined several fellow quadriplegics and moved into semi-independent living at the newly constructed Creekside development—an innovative housing cooperative championed by SCI BC’s Doug Mowat.” It describes later work as a Vancouver Coastal Health peer counsellor at GF Strong.

The spelling **Creekside** conflicts with Creekview 202 in Haw 1989, the SCI BC history page, and Fayerman 2018. This archive does not decide that they are the same place, though later writers treat them as the 1985 Granville Island / False Creek project.

## Open questions

- Whether “Creekside” is a slip, an alternate name, or a different development.
- What “championed by … Doug Mowat” rests on besides this later sentence.
